In your policy, 'you' and 'your' refer to the named insured shown in the declarations and the spouse if a resident of the same household.
'Actual cash value' is the policy's term for what your property is worth today, after depreciation is subtracted.
What's an 'occurrence'? It's the policy's word for an accident, including repeated exposure to the same harmful conditions.
'Covered expenses' means reasonable charges for medically necessary services that are incurred while coverage is in force.
For this rider, 'Chronic illness' means the insured cannot perform at least two activities of daily living without substantial assistance.
'Insured vehicle' means the vehicle described in the declarations and any temporary substitute.
'Policy year' refers to each 12-month period starting on the policy date.
'Primary care physician' means the in-network doctor you choose to coordinate your care.
The policy defines 'Bodily injury' to include sickness and disease but not mental anguish alone.
'Your product' means any goods manufactured, sold, handled, or distributed by you.
In plain English, 'subrogation' is the insurer's right to go after whoever caused your loss after paying your claim.
'Total loss' means damage so severe that the cost to repair exceeds the actual cash value of the vehicle.
As used in this plan, 'Out-of-pocket maximum' means the most you pay in a plan year for covered services.
'Traveling companion' means a person who has coordinated travel arrangements with you and intends to travel with you.
'Domestic partner' means a person with whom you share a residence and a committed relationship, as certified in an affidavit.
'Workplace' means any location where an employee is performing duties for the employer.
'Personal and advertising injury' means injury arising out of offenses such as libel, slander, false arrest, or the use of another's advertising idea.
'Sound natural tooth' means a tooth that is whole or properly restored and free from decay.
A 'Deductible' is the amount you pay for covered services before the plan starts to pay.
'Earned premium' means the portion of the premium that applies to the expired part of the policy period.
'Insured event' refers to any of the perils listed in Section 2 that occur during the period of insurance.
'Reasonable and customary charge' means the amount usually charged for a similar service in the same geographic area.
What does 'declarations page' mean? It's the summary at the front of your policy listing your coverages, limits, and premium.
'Coverage territory' means the United States, its territories and possessions, Puerto Rico, and Canada.
'Elimination period' is the number of days you must be disabled before benefits begin.
'Rider' means an amendment attached to the policy that adds or changes benefits.
'Immediate family member' means your spouse, parent, child, sibling, or grandparent.
'Unoccupied' means the dwelling is not being lived in, though it may still contain furnishings.
'Specified disease' means cancer, heart attack, stroke, or kidney failure as diagnosed by a physician.
'Hospital confinement' means a stay of at least 24 hours as a registered inpatient.
'Executive officer' means a person holding any of the officer positions created by your charter or bylaws.
'Mechanical breakdown' means the failure of a part that results in damage, not due to wear and tear.
In this certificate, 'Child' includes a stepchild, adopted child, or foster child who depends on you for support.
'Owner' means the person who has all rights in the policy, including the right to name the beneficiary.
'Medical emergency' means a sudden onset of a condition that requires immediate treatment to prevent serious harm.
'Professional services' means services requiring specialized knowledge or training, such as legal, medical, or engineering advice.
The term 'Regular use' means use of a vehicle that is frequent and not merely occasional.
'Injured worker' means any employee who sustains a compensable injury under this policy.
'Dwelling' means the house on the residence premises used principally as a private residence.
'Insured's legal representative' means the person or company appointed by a court to act for the insured.
'Maximum medical improvement' means the point at which an injured employee's condition is not expected to improve further.
'Accidental bodily injury' means injury caused by an accident that results directly and independently of all other causes.
A 'Pre-certification' is the approval the plan must give before certain services are provided.
'Trip cost' means the prepaid, non-refundable payments for travel arrangements that you have insured.
'Underinsured motor vehicle' means a vehicle whose liability limits are less than the damages you are legally entitled to recover.
'Fungi' means any type or form of fungus, including mold or mildew, and any mycotoxins, spores, or scents produced by them.
'Annuitant' means the person on whose life annuity payments are based.
'Supplies' means items and materials necessary for treatment, excluding personal convenience items.
'Temporary worker' means a person furnished to you to substitute for a permanent employee on leave or to meet short-term workload conditions.
For coverage under this plan, 'Network' means the group of doctors, hospitals, and other providers that contract with us.
'Grace period' means the 31 days following a premium due date during which coverage remains in force.
'Hostile fire' means a fire that becomes uncontrollable or breaks out from where it was intended to be.
